scanNote:
Culture Clips bo'limining 2-mavzusi: 'Canadian Cities' (Kanada shaharlari). Bosilgan bet raqami: 156.

Betda:
• Sarlavha: '2 Canadian Cities'
• Chapda 'Pre-reading Activity' — 1, 2, 3-mashqlar
• O'ngda 'Reading' — 4a (T/F, 5 ta gap) va 4b (zid ma'noli so'zlar)
• Katta rangli KANADA XARITASI: Alaska (USA), Nunavut, Baker Lake, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec, Hudson Bay, Pacific Ocean, Atlantic Ocean, United States of America; shaharlar — Vancouver, Victoria, Winnipeg, Quebec, Montreal, Ottawa, Toronto. O'ng pastda qizil kompas (N, S, E, W).
• Ikkita dumaloq surat: A — totem ustuni (qora-oq-sariq bo'yalgan qush boshi); B — Ottavadagi Parlament tepaligi va qizil kamzulli, qora qalpoqli harbiy paradchilar

⚠ C, D, E suratlari 157-betda.

⚠⚠ 4a va 4b mashqlari IKKI BETGA yoyilgan: matnlar 157-betda. Javob topish uchun ikkala betni ham o'qish kerak.

⚠ HALOL IZOH: 157-betdagi matnda 'Indian totem poles' iborasi ishlatilgan. Bu — eski atama. Hozirgi ingliz tilida Kanadaning tub aholisi haqida 'First Nations' yoki 'Indigenous peoples' deyiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: 1  Look at the pictures (A-E). Which shows ... a Chinese pagoda? a totem pole? a cafe? a military parade? an art gallery and gardens?
exercises.instructionUz: 1  Rasmlarga qarang (A-E). Qaysi birida ... xitoy pagodasi? totem ustuni? kafe? harbiy parad? san'at galereyasi va bog'lari bor?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'PRE-READING ACTIVITY' —
matnni o'qishdan OLDINGI mashq.

  Maqsadi: rasmlarga qarab mavzu bilan
  tanishish.


⚠ BESh SURAT IKKI BETGA TARQALGAN:

  156-betda:  A, B
  157-betda:  C, D, E


JAVOBLAR:

  A  — a totem pole
         (totem ustuni)
  B  — a military parade
         (harbiy parad)
  C  — an art gallery and gardens
         (san'at galereyasi va bog'lar)
  D  — a cafe
         (kafe)
  E  — a Chinese pagoda
         (xitoy pagodasi)


⚠ 'TOTEM POLE' NIMA:

  Yog'ochdan o'yib yasalgan, hayvon va
  ruh tasvirlari bilan bezatilgan baland
  ustun.

  Kanada va AQShning shimoli-g'arbiy
  sohilidagi tub xalqlar yasagan.

  ⚠ Har tasvir oilaning tarixini yoki
  afsonani bildiradi — bu 'but' emas,
  OILA TARIXI yozilgan yodgorlik.

  ⚠ A suratda: qora, oq va sariq rangda
  bo'yalgan katta qush boshi (ehtimol
  burgut yoki qarg'a).


⚠ HALOL IZOH — ESKI ATAMA:

  157-betdagi matnda 'INDIAN totem poles'
  deyilgan.

  Bu — ESKI atama. Hozirgi ingliz tilida
  Kanadaning tub aholisi haqida:
     'First Nations'
     'Indigenous peoples'
  deyiladi.

  ⚠ Kitob yozilgan davrda 'Indian' keng
  ishlatilar edi.


⚠ 'CAFE' — FRANSUZChA SO'Z:

  'a cafe' (yoki 'cafe' urg'u belgisi
  bilan) — fransuz tilidan kirgan.

  ⚠ Oxirgi 'e' O'QILADI: [KA-fey].
  Fransuzcha so'zlarda oxirgi 'e' jim
  bo'lmaydi.

  ⚠ Solishtiring: 'name' [neym] — bu
  yerda 'e' JIM.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a totem pole = totem ustuni
  a pagoda     = pagoda
  a cafe       = kafe
  a parade     = parad
  military     = harbiy
  an art gallery = san'at galereyasi
  a garden     = bog'

pairs.leftUz: A — qora, oq va sariq rangda bo'yalgan katta qush boshi o'yilgan yog'och ustun
pairs.whyUz:
Yog'ochdan o'yilgan, hayvon va ruh
tasvirlari bilan bezatilgan baland ustun.

Kanada va AQShning shimoli-g'arbiy
sohilidagi tub xalqlar yasagan.

⚠ Har tasvir oila tarixini yoki afsonani
bildiradi.

⚠ 157-betdagi matnda Vankuverdagi Stanley
Parkda totem ustunlari borligi aytilgan.

pairs.leftUz: B — Parlament tepaligi va qizil kamzulli, qora qalpoqli askarlar saf tortgan
pairs.whyUz:
Ottavadagi Parliament Hill.

157-betdagi matnda: 'Parliament Hill is a
popular tourist spot where visitors can
watch MILITARY PARADES.'

⚠ Qizil kamzul va qora mo'ynali qalpoq —
Britaniya an'anasidan qolgan marosim
kiyimi (Kanada — Hamdo'stlik a'zosi).

pairs.leftUz: C — shishali zamonaviy bino va oldida qizil-sariq gulzorlar
pairs.whyUz:
Ottavadagi Kanada Milliy galereyasi.

157-betdagi matnda: 'Ottawa is also the
home of Canada's National Gallery. It is
SURROUNDED BY beautiful GARDENS.'

⚠ Ichkarida 25 000 dan ortiq san'at asari
bor.

pairs.leftUz: D — ko'chadagi soyabonli kafe, stollar atrofida odamlar, yonidan yo'lovchilar o'tyapti
pairs.whyUz:
Monrealning eski qismidagi Yevropa
uslubidagi kafe.

157-betdagi matnda: 'Old Montreal is very
popular with tourists because of its narrow
streets, old buildings and EUROPEAN-STYLE
CAFES and restaurants.'

⚠ 'cafe' oxirgi 'e' O'QILADI: [KA-fey].

pairs.leftUz: E — qayrilgan cherepitsali tomlari, qizil yog'och devorlari bo'lgan ko'p qavatli minora
pairs.whyUz:
Monrealdagi Botanika bog'ining Xitoy
bog'idagi pagoda.

157-betdagi matnda: 'The Chinese Garden is
beautiful and it has a huge COLOURFUL
PAGODA.'

⚠ AYNAN SHU SURAT Culture Clips bo'limining
muqovasida (145-bet) ham ishlatilgan!

exercises.instructionEn: 2  Look at the map and point to: Vancouver, Montreal, Ottawa.   3  Which one is in the south-west of Canada? Which two are in the south-east of Canada?
exercises.instructionUz: 2  Xaritaga qarang va ko'rsating: Vankuver, Monreal, Ottava.   3  Qaysi biri Kanadaning janubi-g'arbida? Qaysi ikkitasi janubi-sharqida?
exercises.explanationUz:
XARITA MASHQI.

  Kitob 2 va 3-mashqlarni ketma-ket
  bergan: avval shaharlarni topish,
  keyin ularning joyini aytish.


JAVOBLAR:

  3-mashq:
     JANUBI-G'ARBDA  →  VANCOUVER
     JANUBI-ShARQDA  →  OTTAWA va
                        MONTREAL


XARITADAGI SHAHARLAR (g'arbdan sharqqa):

  Victoria    — eng g'arbda, orolda
  Vancouver   — Tinch okeani sohilida
  Winnipeg    — o'rtada (Manitoba)
  Toronto     — janubi-sharqda (Ontario)
  Ottawa      — janubi-sharqda (POYTAXT)
  Montreal    — janubi-sharqda (Quebec)
  Quebec      — janubi-sharqda
  Baker Lake  — shimolda (Nunavut)


XARITADAGI O'LKALAR:

  British Columbia — g'arbda
  Manitoba         — o'rtada
  Ontario          — janubi-sharqda
  Quebec           — sharqda
  Nunavut          — shimolda


XARITADAGI SUVLAR va QO'ShNILAR:

  Pacific Ocean  — Tinch okeani (g'arbda)
  Atlantic Ocean — Atlantika (sharqda)
  Hudson Bay     — Gudzon ko'rfazi
                   (o'rtada)
  Alaska (USA)   — shimoli-g'arbda
  United States of America — janubda


⚠ 'SOUTH-WEST' va 'SOUTH-EAST':

  ⚠ Ingliz tilida ShIMOL-JANUB OLDIN,
  ShARQ-G'ARB KEYIN:
     south-west  ✓
     west-south  ✗

  ⚠ 145-betdagi kompas izohiga qarang.


⚠ KANADA HAQIDA:

  • Maydoni bo'yicha dunyoda IKKINChI
    (Rossiyadan keyin)
  • Poytaxti — OTTAWA (Toronto EMAS,
    Vankuver ham EMAS!)
  • Ikki davlat tili: INGLIZ va FRANSUZ
  • Kanadada 10 ta o'lka (province) va
    3 ta hudud (territory) bor

  ⚠ Nunavut — 1999-yilda tashkil etilgan
  eng yangi hudud; aholisining ko'pi
  inuitlar.

  ⚠ Workbook 40-betdagi inuitlar haqidagi
  matnga qarang.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a map      = xarita
  to point to = ko'rsatmoq
  south-west = janubi-g'arb
  south-east = janubi-sharq
  an ocean   = okean
  a bay      = ko'rfaz
  a province = o'lka

items.textEn: 3  Which one is in the south-west of Canada?
items.whyUz:
⚠ VANCOUVER.

Xaritada eng chapda (g'arbda), Tinch
okeani sohilida, British Columbia
o'lkasida.

⚠ 157-betdagi matnda ham: 'great views of
the PACIFIC OCEAN, to the west'.

items.textEn: 3  Which two are in the south-east of Canada?  (birinchisi)
items.whyUz:
⚠ OTTAWA — Ontario o'lkasida, xaritaning
o'ng pastida.

⚠ OTTAWA — KANADANING POYTAXTI.
Bu 4a mashqining 1-gapiga ham kerak
bo'ladi.

items.textEn: 3  Which two are in the south-east of Canada?  (ikkinchisi)
items.whyUz:
⚠ MONTREAL — Quebec o'lkasida, Ottavadan
o'ngroqda.

⚠ Monrealda aholining uchdan ikki qismi
FRANSUZ tilida gapiradi.

items.textEn: Which city is the capital of Canada?
items.whyUz:
⚠ OTTAWA.

157-betdagi matnda: 'OTTAWA, THE CAPITAL
CITY OF CANADA, is a wonderful mixture of
old and new buildings.'

⚠⚠ ENG KO'P XATO: ko'pchilik Toronto yoki
Vankuverni poytaxt deb o'ylaydi. Toronto —
eng katta shahar, lekin poytaxt EMAS.

exercises.instructionEn: 4  a) Read the texts and mark the statements T (true) or F (false). Then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: 4  a) Matnlarni o'qing va gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang. So'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠⚠ MATNLAR 157-BETDA!

  Uchta matn bor: Vancouver, Ottawa,
  Montreal.

  ⚠ 154-betdagi mashqda uch xil javob
  bor edi (Right/Wrong/Doesn't Say).
  Bu yerda esa faqat IKKI xil: T yoki F.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  F  — poytaxt OTTAWA
  2  F  — Canada Place park EMAS
  3  T  — Xitoy bog'i Monrealda
  4  T  — Ottavada ikki tilda gapirishadi
  5  F  — 'sixty', 'OVER sixty' emas


⚠⚠ 5-BAND — ENG NOZIK JOY:

  Matnda: 'With MORE THAN twenty-five
  other museums, SIXTY annual festivals
  and a wildlife park...'

  ⚠ 'more than' faqat MUZEYLARGA tegishli
  ('more than twenty-five museums').

  ⚠ Bayramlar soni esa ANIQ: 'sixty'
  ('more than sixty' EMAS).

  ⚠ Gap 'OVER 60' deyapti — demak NOTO'G'RI.

  ⚠ Bu — juda nozik farq. Diqqat bilan
  o'qish kerak: bir gapda ikki xil son
  berilgan, 'more than' faqat birinchisiga
  tegishli.


⚠ 'OVER' = 'MORE THAN':

     'over 60'      = 60 dan ORTIQ
     'more than 60' = 60 dan ORTIQ

  ⚠ Ikkalasi bir xil ma'noda.

  ⚠ 'sixty' esa ANIQ 60.


⚠ 2-BAND HAQIDA:

  Matnda Canada Place'da nima borligi
  sanalgan:
     'a conference centre, a luxury hotel,
      a huge cinema and special events'

  ⚠ PARK haqida gap YO'Q!

  ⚠ Vankuverdagi park — STANLEY PARK,
  bu boshqa joy.

  ⚠ TUZOQ: ikkala nom ham matnda bor,
  lekin ular BOShQA-BOShQA joylar.

items.textEn: 1  Vancouver is the capital of Canada.
items.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (F).

157-betdagi Ottawa matnida:
'OTTAWA, THE CAPITAL CITY OF CANADA...'

⚠ Vankuver — go'zal shahar, lekin poytaxt
EMAS.

⚠ Toronto ham poytaxt emas (u eng katta
shahar).

items.textEn: 2  Canada Place is a large park.
items.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (F).

Matnda Canada Place'da nima borligi
sanalgan:
'a CONFERENCE CENTRE, a luxury HOTEL,
a huge CINEMA and special EVENTS'.

⚠ Park haqida gap YO'Q.

⚠⚠ TUZOQ: Vankuverdagi park — STANLEY
PARK, u boshqa joy. Ikkala nom ham matnda
bor, lekin ular boshqa-boshqa.

items.textEn: 3  The Chinese Garden is in Montreal.
items.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (T).

157-betdagi Montreal matnining oxirida:
'THE CHINESE GARDEN is beautiful and it
has a huge colourful pagoda.'

⚠ E suratdagi pagoda aynan shu bog'da.
Shu surat 145-betdagi bo'lim muqovasida
ham bor.

items.textEn: 4  People in Ottawa speak French and English.
items.uz: Ottavada odamlar fransuz va ingliz tilida gapirishadi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (T).

157-betdagi Ottawa matnida:
'The people are friendly and speak BOTH
FRENCH AND ENGLISH.'

⚠ 'BOTH ... AND' = ham ..., ham ...

⚠ Kanadaning IKKI davlat tili bor: ingliz
va fransuz.

items.uz: Ottavada yiliga 60 dan ortiq bayram bo'ladi.
items.whyUz:
⚠⚠ NOTO'G'RI (F) — BU BETDAGI ENG NOZIK
BAND!

Matnda: 'With MORE THAN twenty-five other
museums, SIXTY annual festivals and a
wildlife park...'

⚠ 'more than' faqat MUZEYLARGA tegishli.
⚠ Bayramlar soni ANIQ: 'sixty'.

⚠ Gap esa 'OVER 60' (60 dan ORTIQ) deyapti
— matn buni tasdiqlamaydi.

⚠ Bir gapda ikki son berilganda, 'more than'
qaysi soniga tegishli ekaniga DIQQAT qiling.

exercises.instructionEn: 4  b) Match the highlighted words to their opposites in the list: dirty, plain, new, small, ugly.
exercises.instructionUz: 4  b) Ta'kidlangan so'zlarni ro'yxatdagi zid ma'noli so'zlar bilan moslang: dirty, plain, new, small, ugly.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ TA'KIDLANGAN (sariq rangda) SO'ZLAR
157-BETDA.

  Ular beshta:
     clean, huge, beautiful, old, colourful

  Ro'yxatda ham beshta so'z bor — demak
  har biriga bittadan juft.


BARCHA JUFTLAR:

  clean     ↔  dirty   (toza / iflos)
  huge      ↔  small   (ulkan / kichik)
  beautiful ↔  ugly    (go'zal / xunuk)
  old       ↔  new     (eski / yangi)
  colourful ↔  plain   (rang-barang /
                        sodda, bezaksiz)


⚠ ENG QIYIN JUFT — 'COLOURFUL ↔ PLAIN':

  'plain' — ko'p ma'noli so'z:
     1) SODDA, BEZAKSIZ, bir rangli
        ← bu yerda shu ma'noda
     2) tekislik (OT)
     3) oddiy, tushunarli
        ('in plain English')

  ⚠ 'a plain shirt' = bir rangli,
     naqshsiz ko'ylak
  ⚠ 'a colourful shirt' = rang-barang
     ko'ylak


⚠ 'COLOURFUL' — YOZILIShI:

     BrE: colour → colourful
     AmE: color  → colorful

  ⚠ Kitob BRITANIYA imlosida yozilgan —
  'colour' ('u' harfi bilan).

  ⚠ Shu qoidadagi boshqa so'zlar:
     favourite / favorite
     neighbour / neighbor
     centre    / center


⚠ 'HUGE' va 'BIG':

     'big'  = katta
     'huge' = ULKAN (juda katta)

  ⚠ 'huge' kuchliroq. Uning zid ma'nosi
  ro'yxatda 'small' berilgan (aniqrog'i
  'tiny' bo'lardi).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  clean     = toza
  dirty     = iflos
  huge      = ulkan
  small     = kichik
  beautiful = go'zal
  ugly      = xunuk
  old       = eski
  new       = yangi
  colourful = rang-barang
  plain     = sodda, bezaksiz

pairs.whyUz:
Matnda: 'It has CLEAN streets and green
parks.'

⚠ 'clean' — sifat ham, fe'l ham:
  'clean streets' (sifat) = toza ko'chalar
  'to clean the room' (fe'l) = xona
  tozalamoq.

Matnda: '... and HUGE mountains to the
east.'

⚠ 'huge' = ULKAN ('big' dan kuchliroq).

⚠ Matnda 'huge' uch marta uchraydi:
'huge mountains', 'a huge cinema',
'a huge colourful pagoda'.

Matnda: 'It is surrounded by BEAUTIFUL
gardens.'

⚠ 'beautiful' — uzun sifat, qiyosiy
darajasi 'MORE beautiful'.

⚠ 'ugly' — qisqa sifat, qiyosiy darajasi
'uglIER'.

Matnda: '... narrow streets, OLD buildings
and European-style cafes.'

⚠ Ottawa matnida ham ikkalasi birga
kelgan: 'a wonderful mixture of OLD AND
NEW buildings'.

⚠ 'old' ikki ma'noda: eski (narsa) va
keksa (odam).

⚠ ENG QIYIN JUFT.

Matnda: '... a huge COLOURFUL pagoda.'

⚠ 'plain' bu yerda 'SODDA, BEZAKSIZ,
BIR RANGLI' ma'nosida:
  'a plain shirt' = naqshsiz ko'ylak

⚠ 'plain' ning boshqa ma'nolari:
tekislik (ot); oddiy, tushunarli
('in plain English').

⚠ 'colourful' — BRITANIYA imlosi
(AmE: 'colorful').

wordFormation.introUz: Zid ma'noli so'zlar va Kanada lug'ati.
